question: Who is the ultimate agent behind the concealment and revelation of awareness?
premises: The processes of forgetting and recognition occur within awareness.
The Lord Bhairava is consciousness in nature.
By his freedom he conceals and reveals his own form.
inference: The alternation of concealment and revelation in cognition is ultimately the free activity of Bhairava, whose nature is consciousness.
plain_english: In all of this, the Lord Bhairava, whose very nature is consciousness, freely conceals and reveals his own form.
